CHEATS WILL TRIGGER ACHIEVEMENTS. Saved changes remain after removing the mod.

Light Respec keeps Ultimates and broad earned protections. Medium removes Ultimates too. Full restores only Compel Soul, Astral Communion, Voracious Bite, Mercurial Fervour and Wolf Transform after the native reset.

Font of Life and Mandrake Ward may survive even Full Respec because the game-native ResetAllTraits operation does not clear them. Legendary-consumable or earned-rank differences may become skill points; consumed items are not restored.

Grant Specific Perk searches the complete loaded trait database and directly sets one chosen perk to a requested valid rank. It bypasses prerequisites, exclusivity, manuals, quests and skill-point cost.
Bulk Unlock maxes ordinary, hidden, manual, quest and boss traits and marks recipe/manual-based skill access as learned/read. It may be used repeatedly.
Give Manual adds the physical skill manual only. Duplicate or out-of-order manuals may not provide another unlock.

Give All Equipment is limited to Weapons and Clothing. Bulk recipes, consumables, materials and junk are excluded after a native crash was traced to Recipe4. Levelled equipment uses the selected Item Level. Wait for completion before saving or loading.
Give Key adds only the physical key, not its quest event. Keys can duplicate, remain permanently, bypass progression or mismatch quest state.
